title: Layered hydraulic authority falsification
motivation: Source review found that the adaptive cache key and table construction use initialized cofgen(:,1), while SWAP profiles may contain node-varying hydraulic parameterizations. Existing admission matrices vary material between cases but use one material within each profile.
question: Does the extracted adaptive provider reproduce the authoritative B1.10 constitutive response when one vertical profile contains two distinct hydraulic materials?
decision_rule: If the lower-material response is not within the existing constitutive tolerances, PR #606 remains draft and single-authority-per-provider ownership is rejected for canonical admission. Repair must represent each unique initialized hydraulic authority separately or explicitly restrict admission to homogeneous profiles; silent reuse of node-1 authority is not admissible.
